summary: Seven new regional sources: Arabic criticism, Indian regional-canon reporting, Brazilian fiction review, African personal selection, Arabic translation guide and author-focused criticism, Indonesian primary excerpt with translator commentary. Failed Africultures retrieval remains uncounted.
next: Continue multilingual criticism and direct reader discussions; broaden philosophy using independently authored arguments.
